nodes.label: Check Valve Adaptor (117-C)
nodes.author: D. Ling
nodes.rationale: Mounting/adaptor plate for a check valve. Drawing no. 117-C, Model No. 90B, material 1018 (also listed under heat treatment). Front view 4.44in x 3.81in, a 1.00in-thick side view, and a bottom view. Features: 4x .656in (21/32) thru holes (mounting), 2x .281in (9/32) drilled .31in deep holes, 2x .906in (29/32) drilled .50in deep holes with a 1.311in dia x .111in deep counterbore/spot-face (likely valve-seat pockets), and 2x .25in dowel-pin holes (.31in deep, ream press-fit) with 2 required .25in dia x .50in long dowels. Title block notes '(FOR C56815)', indicating this part mates with/adapts to assembly C56815. Drawn by D. Ling, Jan 17 1977.

nodes.label: Check Bypass Plate (115C)
nodes.author: D. Ling
nodes.rationale: Plate titled 'CHECK BYPASS', with a note 'REPLACES C5G-805 CHECK VALVE'. Drawing no. 115C, Model No. 90B, material 1018. Front view ~2.75in x 1.88in, side view 1.50in x .75in, bottom view 3.25in long. Features: 4x .406in (13/32) dia thru holes, 2x .578in (37/64) drilled holes 1.12in deep with a 1.002in dia counterbore .111in deep, a 3/8-18 NPTF tapered pipe-thread port drilled 2.38in deep, and a ground-flat ('GR. FLAT') surface callout. Drawn by D. Ling, Jan 15 1977.

nodes.label: A040911E Bearing - Front View
nodes.author: J. Schmeltz
nodes.rationale: Front (circular) close-up view of bearing A040911E showing 3 drilled & counterbored holes (.38 DP for .250 SOC HD CAP SCR) plus tapped-hole locations, on a 2.875 (vertical) / 2.490 (horizontal) bolt circle, 6.498 DIA OD, 4.500 DIA bore, and a concentricity callout to datum A within .001.

nodes.label: A040911E Bearing - Full Drawing
nodes.author: J. Schmeltz
nodes.rationale: Full engineering drawing of MTI part A040911E, a bronze (AMPCO 18) flanged bearing/bushing, model 100TFW, dwg 4091-B. Front view shows 6.498 DIA flange OD, 4.500 DIA bore, 3 counterbored holes on a 2.875/2.490 bolt circle for .250 socket-head cap screws, and 2 tapped holes (.375-16, 1.00 DP). Side view shows a 1.500 long cylindrical body with .06x45 chamfers and perpendicularity/flatness/concentricity callouts to datum A. Title block: drawn by J. Schmeltz, checked E.E.F, dated Dec 29 1987.

nodes.label: A040911E Bearing - Side Section View
nodes.author: J. Schmeltz
nodes.rationale: Side (sectioned) close-up view of bearing A040911E showing overall length 1.500, stepped wall geometry, .06x45 chamfer typ, surface finish callouts (125/63 microinch), and perpendicularity .001 to datum A.

nodes.label: Ambiguous Dimension Flagging (resolution_required)
nodes.rationale: When a dimension's meaning is geometrically plausible under more than one reading, the pipeline proceeds with a best-guess value, records candidate values, and surfaces a HUMAN MUST CONFIRM warning rather than silently blocking or silently guessing without disclosure.

nodes.label: Bounding Cylinder Approximation for Revolved Shafts
nodes.norm_label: bounding cylinder approximation for revolved shafts
nodes.rationale: The automated builder cannot revolve an arbitrary profile, so a turned/revolved shaft (SB11780) was approximated as a bounding cylinder (largest OD x overall length) pending a manual revolve, rather than left entirely unbuilt.

nodes.label: Drawing Frame Coordinate Convention
nodes.rationale: E003: mixing a centered-origin plate with edge-referenced hole positions from the drawing put holes outside the material. Fix: base plate lower-left corner at the origin so edge-referenced drawing positions are sketch coordinates directly — one coordinate frame for everything.

nodes.label: Static Macro Self-Validation
nodes.rationale: pipeline/macro_audit.py scans every generated .vba for banned/nonexistent APIs (e.g. GetModelBoundingBox) and structural defects so a known failure mode can no longer ship even if the generator regresses; generate_macro_package raises on error-severity findings.

nodes.label: POSITION ASSUMED Placeholder Convention
nodes.rationale: When a feature/hole position isn't dimensioned from the origin, macros center the geometry and flag it POSITION ASSUMED rather than guess silently, so a human must verify before trusting the model.

nodes.label: Prohibited Feature Types Policy (loft/sweep/shell/…)
nodes.rationale: Loft, sweep, boundary, shell, draft, surfacing, and helical threads are never generated by the macro generator — flagged in the build plan and skipped; threads are cosmetic only. Reduces risk of unreliable, hard-to-verify generated geometry.

nodes.label: SolidWorks Macro-Recorder Pattern (active-sketch consumption)
nodes.rationale: E006: fighting the API by closing and re-selecting a sketch by name was unreliable. SolidWorks' own macro recorder never closes/reselects — it calls the feature method while the sketch is still active. Generated VBA now mirrors that: draw, ClearSelection2, call the feature method directly on the active sketch.

nodes.label: E001: No Default Part Template Configured
nodes.norm_label: e001: no default part template configured
nodes.rationale: GetUserPreferenceStringValue(swDefaultTemplatePart) returns empty on machines where default templates were never set (fresh installs, school VDI). Rule adopted: never trust a user preference to be set; always have a filesystem-discovery fallback.

nodes.label: E002: Could Not Select Front Plane
nodes.norm_label: e002: could not select front plane
nodes.rationale: Plane names are template- and language-dependent, so hard-coded name selection is brittle. Rule adopted: never select reference geometry by a single hard-coded name; always provide a position-in-tree fallback.

nodes.label: E003: Holes Placed Outside the Material
nodes.norm_label: e003: holes placed outside the material
nodes.rationale: Two coordinate frames were mixed: drawings dimension feature positions from part edges while the generator modeled the base plate centered on the origin, placing a hole outside the material.

nodes.label: E004: GetModelBoundingBox Invented API
nodes.rationale: GetModelBoundingBox does not exist on IModelDoc2 — an invented API, silently masked by try/except in the Python COM path too. Rule adopted: every generated API call must be verified against documentation or a recorded macro; a regression test fails the build if it reappears.

nodes.label: E005: FeatureCut4 Returns Nothing
nodes.rationale: Cause: a Through-All cut aimed away from material, implicit reliance on a just-closed sketch selection, or mixed old/new macro state. Rule adopted: cuts must be direction-proof (swEndCondThroughAllBoth) and selection-explicit.

nodes.label: E006: Could Not Select the Profile Sketch
nodes.norm_label: e006: could not select the profile sketch
nodes.rationale: The E005 fix's name-based sketch reselection was itself unreliable. Rule adopted: mirror the macro recorder — call the feature method directly on the still-active sketch; never close and re-find by name.

nodes.label: E007: Pattern Demanded Unneeded Manual Work
nodes.norm_label: e007: pattern demanded unneeded manual work
nodes.rationale: The generator emitted a manual-pattern skeleton without checking whether the parent hole feature's cut had already produced every instance. Rule adopted: never ask the user to do something the build plan can prove is already done.

nodes.label: E008: Unicode Console Crash Printing Report
nodes.norm_label: e008: unicode console crash printing report
nodes.rationale: UnicodeEncodeError printing '→' to a cp1252 Windows console killed the run after a paid extraction succeeded, before macros were generated. Rule adopted: always run with PYTHONUTF8=1 and --debug on Windows; resolved in code by forcing UTF-8 and always persisting the extraction.

nodes.label: E009: Verification BLOCKED on Three Drawings
nodes.norm_label: e009: verification blocked on three drawings
nodes.rationale: Human review of the actual PDFs found incomplete symmetric chains, bogus containment 'chains', 2x2 grids misread as linear patterns, illegible handwritten text, and a wrong part number read from the wrong title-block field. Rule: BLOCKED is workable — patch the saved extraction JSON and regenerate with --from-json at no API cost.

nodes.label: E010: Base Plate Unscriptable — Verbose applies_to Labels
nodes.norm_label: e010: base plate unscriptable — verbose applies_to labels
nodes.rationale: The generator matched applies_to labels exactly but the extractor emitted free-text/view-qualified labels, so the base plate lacked a matched diameter or length+width profile. Rule: envelope dims must carry canonical applies_to values, enforced by schema.canonicalize_applies_to() and is_envelope_label().

nodes.label: Edge Chamfer

nodes.label: Datum Reference / GD&T Control
nodes.rationale: Shared concept for geometric dimensioning and tolerancing callouts (flatness, perpendicularity, concentricity, parallelism) referenced to a labeled datum such as datum A.

nodes.label: Surface Finish / Coating Callout
nodes.rationale: Generic feature type: a callout indicating surface treatment/finish/coating over a section of the part. On SB11780 the mid-shaft 'H  CFS' hand-annotated callout is presumed to denote a finish or hardening/coating spec, but the exact meaning (abbreviation) is not certain from the drawing alone.

nodes.label: Tapped (Threaded) Hole

nodes.label: Equally Spaced Hole Pattern
nodes.rationale: Shared concept for a set of holes explicitly called out as equally spaced around a circle (e.g. 4 holes equally spaced, .218 drill thru).

nodes.rationale: Long flat bar, 12 GA (.105) thick, with numbered leader callouts (1/1, 2/2 at 6.25 IN.) and small oval slots/holes visible near each end; appears to be the primary/full drawing sheet for the part.

nodes.label: A001591E Front View (Small Bushing/Washer)
nodes.rationale: Small circular washer/bushing detail: 1.12 dia outer, .656 dia through bore, .312 length. Scale and geometry are inconsistent with the long bar shown in A001591E (1).png, flagged AMBIGUOUS.

nodes.label: Part A001591E
nodes.rationale: Part grouping node for drawing A001591E, linking the main long-bar view and a front view showing a small bushing/washer whose geometry does not obviously match the bar.

nodes.label: Checkpoint Resume Not Implemented
nodes.rationale: Re-entering a partial COM build is not implemented, only partial-save-on-crash + periodic auto-save, due to the brittleness of persisting/restoring SolidWorks feature-tree state.

nodes.label: Macro Engine Choice: VBA (default) vs COM
nodes.norm_label: macro engine choice: vba (default) vs com
nodes.rationale: VBA macro generation is the default engine because it runs on any OS and the generated macros run on any SolidWorks machine with no Python install; direct COM build (--engine com) requires Windows + SolidWorks 2024.

nodes.label: Forced Tool Call Extraction Pattern
nodes.rationale: Adopted for v2 because strict structured outputs reject the extraction schema's nested arrays; validated against the Pydantic schema with one repair retry.

nodes.label: Structured Outputs via messages.parse
nodes.rationale: Originally adopted (Key decisions section) to replace a prompt-only 'return raw JSON' + regex-fallback approach and guarantee schema-valid JSON; later superseded in the v2 update by the forced-tool-call pattern because strict structured outputs reject this schema's nested arrays.

nodes.label: Unit Conversion to Meters (to_meters/assert_meters)
nodes.rationale: The SolidWorks API works in meters. Python COM path routes every value through to_meters()+assert_meters(); the VBA path writes every value as <drawing value> * UNIT_FACTOR for traceability.

nodes.label: Socket Head Cap Screw Clearance Feature
nodes.norm_label: socket head cap screw clearance feature
nodes.rationale: A drilled and counterbored hole sized to pass and seat a .312-18 socket head cap screw; called out on the KEY drawing A001351E for fastening the key in an assembly.

nodes.label: On-Disk Extraction Cache
nodes.rationale: Returns an identical image+model result with zero API calls, saving cost on repeated/batch runs; disable with --no-extract-cache.

nodes.label: Part 115 C-RevB
nodes.rationale: Part label ambiguity between part number '115 C' and MODEL No. '90 B'; view consistency FAIL because dimension D001 cites an unidentified 'Bottom/Front' view; dimension chains for D001 and D002 each show a 0.005 in discrepancy flagged but judged within general tolerance.

nodes.label: Part 116-C-Rev90B
nodes.rationale: Counterbore depth given as an inverted limit dimension (.111/.113, upper value smaller than lower) requiring human resolution of which is max and which is min; overall part thickness is not explicitly dimensioned and was inferred from section A-A (0.94); dimension D017 flagged ambiguous and resolved with a best guess.

nodes.label: Part 117-C-RevB
nodes.rationale: Overall height dimension chain (3.81) does not close against its components (0.340+2.560+0.340=3.240), suggesting an unaccounted datum shift or spacing between hole rows and edges; five features (F001, F003-F006) are each driven by REF (non-controlling) dimensions rather than driving dimensions, requiring verification that a true driving dimension exists for each.

nodes.label: Part 135-A
nodes.rationale: Hardware-driven part where the counterbore diameter/depth are not explicitly dimensioned and must be derived from the .3125-18 socket-head-cap-screw standard; material is listed only generically as 'KEYSTOCK' with no alloy/grade given.

nodes.label: Part A040911E
nodes.rationale: Flanged bore part built with only 2 of 5 features (F001 base flange, F002 through bore); the 3x counterbore holes (F003) and their 120-degree circular pattern (F004) were left unbuilt because bolt-circle hole positions need manual placement, and the .06x45 chamfer (F005) was skipped because InsertFeatureChamfer returned None; dimensions D004 (2.875, bolt-circle radius vs flange half-height) and D005 (2.49, bolt-circle diameter vs flange neck width) remain ambiguous pending human confirmation.

nodes.label: Part A040921E
nodes.rationale: Bearing-ring-like part (10.50 in OD disk, 9.002 in through bore) built with only the base cylinder and bore (F001, F002); the central hub/boss F003 was omitted because its profile is ambiguous (drawing view is cropped, hub height above the disk face is unknown), and the .09x45 chamfer F004 was skipped because InsertFeatureChamfer returned None. No title block (part name, number, revision, material, finish, scale) is visible on the drawing.

nodes.label: Part SB-11033
nodes.rationale: Machined flanged bushing/adapter built with base flange, pilot boss, and central stepped precision bore (F001, F003, F002); the 4x .218 in DRILL THRU bolt-circle holes (F004) were left for manual placement, and fillet F007 plus chamfers F005/F006 were skipped because the corresponding SolidWorks API calls (FeatureFillet3, InsertFeatureChamfer) returned None, apparently with no edges resolved/selected.

nodes.label: Part SB11780
nodes.rationale: Long (76.88 in), hand-drawn/sketched turned-and-revolved shaft. Because the automated builder cannot revolve an arbitrary profile, F001 was approximated as a bounding cylinder (dia 2.4985 x 76.88 in) and the true flange/journal/fillet/chamfer features (F002-F005) were left unbuilt pending a manual revolve. Dimension chain D004 vs D005+D006 leaves an unexplained ~0.875 in gap flagged for human review, and the unit system (inch vs mm) was only assumed from typical shaft proportions rather than confirmed from a title block.

nodes.label: Part SB 11842
nodes.rationale: Flanged boss part (5.00 in OD flange x 0.88 in thick, with a 1.50 in dia inner boss) built with F001/F002; the 4x counterbored bolt holes on a 2.125 in radius bolt circle (F003) and their circular pattern (F005) were left for manual placement, with 5/16 SHCS clearance-drill and counterbore dimensions assumed from a standard chart because the drawing callout does not state them explicitly; the .06x45 chamfer (F004) was skipped because InsertFeatureChamfer returned None.

nodes.label: Bounding Cylinder Approximation for Revolved Shaft
nodes.norm_label: bounding cylinder approximation for revolved shaft
nodes.rationale: The automated builder cannot revolve an arbitrary turned-shaft profile extracted from a 2D drawing, so a turned/revolved part's base feature is approximated as a bounding cylinder (largest OD x overall length) with the true stepped profile left for a manual revolve feature; the schema also nominally requires the first feature to be extrude_boss even though geometry calls for a revolve.

nodes.label: Chamfer/Fillet Automated Build Skip
nodes.rationale: Chamfer and fillet features are frequently skipped during the automated SolidWorks build because the API calls InsertFeatureChamfer / FeatureFillet3 return None (often with no edges selected/resolved), leaving the feature to be applied manually afterward.

nodes.label: Dimension Chain Removed as Step-Within-Overall (Not a Closed Loop)
nodes.norm_label: dimension chain removed as step-within-overall (not a closed loop)
nodes.rationale: When a subset of dimensions sums to a value smaller than a stated overall dimension, the pipeline treats the subset as a step WITHIN the overall dimension rather than a fully closed chain, and keeps both the overall dimension and its components as independent values rather than deleting or reconciling either.

nodes.label: Automated Hole/Bolt-Circle Placement Limitation
nodes.rationale: Drilled/patterned hole features are not auto-placed by the pipeline because bolt-circle position plus circular pattern spacing need manual placement; circular/angular spacing is recorded only as a note, not used for feasibility checks or auto-patterning. Affected features are omitted from the build and flagged 'ADD the holes manually per the drawing callouts.'
